name: Mike Bundock
story: Mike Bundock worked with Smallworld in the UK, then established its Australasian operation in 1993, according to his company biography.

Mike Bundock’s work establishing Smallworld’s Australasian operation in 1993 preceded later New Zealand utility projects, including Vector’s GIS migration in 1998–99. These were separate stages in Smallworld’s regional development.
